title: 第13章 诡异的林浩第14章 血祭八荒
lines: 观众席前排数名修士突然抱头惨叫，七窍中飞出缕缕血线没入阵图。
他指甲暴长尺余，在虚空划出九宫血咒：
你以为只有你会请神？
地面突然渗出黑血，八具青铜棺破土而出。
棺盖炸裂的瞬间，柳家席位传来尖叫——那八具干尸竟都穿着柳家服饰！
柳元宗捏碎茶盏，其中一具干尸颈间还挂着柳林幼时的长命锁。
血祭八荒！
天老在林烬识海惊呼，
这小子把方才柳林的血毒炼成尸傀了！
没想到这小子一夜时间就将柳林的血毒炼制成了尸傀！
萧逸的三尸雷神同时睁眼。
持星盘的老者虚影抛洒出银河光带，却在触碰黑血的瞬间变成暗红色；
托药鼎的老妪虚影倾倒出金色液体，落地却化作碧绿毒泉；
青年虚影更是直接魔化，额头生出弯曲羊角。
你竟敢污我萧家英灵！
萧逸眼角迸裂流出血泪，手中雷诀突变杀招。
七颗雷星化作北斗剑阵，
却每柄剑都缠绕着紫黑魔气——他竟被反噬得半身入魔！
林浩狂笑着迎上剑阵，八具毒尸结成血肉屏障。
魔化雷剑贯穿尸阵时，毒血与雷火碰撞出惨绿色蘑菇云。
烟尘中突然刺出五根骨刺，精准扎进萧逸五大气海。
三年前你抢我幽冥雷种时，可想过今日？
林浩獠牙咬住萧逸耳垂，声音却清脆如少年，
这具雷灵根肉身，我收下了。
贵宾席突然炸开灵力波动。
萧青山手持镇族雷印破空而来，林震天的血魔刀却早一步架在其颈间。
萧青山与林震天对峙时，擂台中央突然亮起焚天塔虚影——
竟是林烬不知何时冲入战局！
噬心阵反噬要来了。
天老急促警告，
用九狱炎骨吸收余波！
林浩正要捏碎萧逸天灵盖，突然发现魔气不受控制地涌向林烬。
他惊怒交加地嘶吼：
你竟敢...！
话音未落，七窍突然喷出漆黑火苗——那竟是萧逸体内被污染的雷火！
林烬双手结出莲花印，焚天塔虚影将漫天魔气鲸吞而入。
观众们看到的是淬体六重少年在舍身救人，
唯有萧青山看清了那些魔气正在被淬炼成精纯灵力。
content_en:
Several monks in the front row of the audience suddenly held their heads and screamed, and streaks of blood flew out of their seven orifices and fell into the formation.
His nails grew to more than a foot long, and he drew nine blood curses in the void:
Do you think you are the only one who can ask God?
Black blood suddenly oozed from the ground, and eight bronze coffins broke out of the ground.
The moment the coffin lid exploded, screams came from the Liu family's seats - the eight mummies were actually wearing Liu family clothes!
Liu Yuanzong crushed the tea cup, and one of the mummies still had the longevity lock that Liu Lin had worn when he was young hanging around his neck.
Blood sacrifice to Bahuang!
Tian Lao exclaimed in Lin Jin’s sea of consciousness,
This kid turned Liu Lin's blood poison into a corpse puppet!
Unexpectedly, this kid refined Liu Lin's blood poison into a corpse puppet in one night!
Xiao Yi's three corpse thunder gods opened their eyes at the same time.
The shadow of the old man holding the astrolabe threw out the Milky Way light band, but turned into dark red the moment it touched the black blood;
The shadow of the old woman holding the medicine cauldron poured out golden liquid, but when it hit the ground, it turned into a green poisonous spring;
The young man's shadow was directly transformed into a demon, and curved ram's horns sprouted from his forehead.
How dare you taint my Xiao family’s heroic spirit!
The corners of Xiao Yi's eyes burst into tears, and the Thunder Jue in his hand suddenly made a killing move.
The seven thunder stars turned into the Big Dipper Sword Formation,
But every sword was wrapped with purple and black demonic energy - he was actually half possessed by the backlash!
Lin Hao laughed wildly and faced the sword formation, eight poisonous corpses forming a flesh and blood barrier.
When the demonized thunder sword penetrated the corpse formation, the poisonous blood and thunder fire collided to create a miserable green mushroom cloud.
Five bone spurs suddenly stabbed out of the smoke and pierced into Xiao Yi's five seas of air with precision.
When you snatched my Netherworld Thunder Seed three years ago, did you think about today?
Lin Hao bit Xiao Yi's earlobe with his fangs, but his voice was as clear as a young man's,
I accept this Leilinggen physical body.
The VIP table suddenly exploded with spiritual energy fluctuations.
Xiao Qingshan came through the air holding the Thunder Seal of the Zhen Clan, but Lin Zhentian's Blood Demon Sword was already placed on his neck.
When Xiao Qingshan and Lin Zhentian were confronting each other, the phantom of the Burning Sky Tower suddenly lit up in the center of the arena——
It was Lin Jin who rushed into the battle without knowing when!
The backlash of the Heart-Eating Formation is coming.
God hastily warned,
Use the Nine Hell Flame Bones to absorb the aftermath!
Lin Hao was about to crush Xiao Yitian's spiritual cap when he suddenly noticed that the demonic energy was flowing towards Lin Jin uncontrollably.
He roared in shock and anger:
How dare you...!
Before he finished speaking, the seven orifices suddenly spurted out jet-black flames - that was actually the contaminated thunder fire in Xiao Yi's body!
Lin Jin formed a lotus seal with his hands, and the phantom of the Burning Sky Tower swallowed up the demonic energy in the sky.
What the audience saw was a young man at the sixth level of body tempering sacrificing his life to save others.
Only Xiao Qingshan saw clearly that the demonic energy was being tempered into pure spiritual power.
title_en: Chapter 13 The Weird Lin Hao Chapter 14 Blood Sacrifice to the Eight Wastelands
